workflows.purpose: Validate catalog, contracts, implementations, metadata, and the reusable-workflow smoke path.

failure_semantics.description: Any failed validation or reusable-workflow smoke job fails the workflow; newer work on the same ref cancels stale validation.

workflows.purpose: Validate and publish one immutable repository-wide Relay release, then optionally advance its major discovery alias.

failure_semantics.description: A rerun resumes only when an existing immutable tag resolves to the same validated default-branch commit; contradictory state fails closed.

inputs.name: version
inputs.description: Unused immutable vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH release tag.

inputs.name: update-major-alias
inputs.description: Advance the matching moving major alias after release creation.

workflows.purpose: Review a caller-built publication site, conditionally deploy only its exact validated bytes, and verify canonical and optional fallback HTTPS targets.

failure_semantics.description: Unauthorized deployment requests, invalid local contracts, reviewed-byte drift, Pages failures, or bounded remote-proof failures stop the lifecycle; review evidence remains available where safe.

inputs.name: artifact-name
inputs.description: Complete static-site artifact uploaded by the caller-owned build job.

inputs.name: expected-base-url
inputs.description: Canonical HTTPS base URL recorded in the public catalog.

inputs.name: expected-source-revision
inputs.description: Full caller source commit recorded in the public catalog.

inputs.name: required-routes
inputs.description: JSON array of required site-relative public routes.

inputs.name: catalog-path
inputs.description: Site-relative Beacon publication catalog path.

inputs.name: checksum-path
inputs.description: Site-relative complete checksum inventory path.

inputs.name: fallback-base-url
inputs.description: Optional technical fallback URL that must match the catalog.

inputs.name: verify-fallback
inputs.description: Verify every route and byte through the fallback URL.

inputs.name: deploy-enabled
inputs.description: Explicitly request an authorized default-branch or manual deployment.

inputs.name: artifact-retention-days
inputs.description: Retention for review and deployment-evidence artifacts.

inputs.name: verification-attempts
inputs.description: Maximum bounded attempts per remote resource.

inputs.name: verification-retry-delay-seconds
inputs.description: Bounded delay between remote verification attempts.

inputs.name: verification-request-timeout-seconds
inputs.description: Bounded application request timeout.

inputs.name: verification-max-elapsed-seconds
inputs.description: Bounded application-level remote verification deadline.

outputs.name: review-artifact-name
outputs.description: Unique ordinary artifact containing the exact reviewed site bytes.

outputs.name: evidence-artifact-name
outputs.description: Validation or deployment evidence artifact name.

outputs.name: page-url
outputs.description: Pages deployment URL when deployment is enabled.

outputs.name: file-count
outputs.description: Number of files in the reviewed site.

outputs.name: site-tree-sha256
outputs.description: SHA-256 of the complete sorted SHA256SUMS bytes.

outputs.name: total-bytes
outputs.description: Total byte count of the reviewed site.

workflows.purpose: Build, provenance-check, and upload one routed repository intelligence site, including its roadmap quest line, ADR decision ledger, and semantic Git journey, as a bounded workflow artifact.

failure_semantics.description: Generation, provenance validation, missing output, or upload failure prevents the artifact output from being reported.

inputs.name: output-directory
inputs.description: Generated Repository Intelligence site directory within the checked-out caller repository.

inputs.name: work-directory
inputs.description: Private collection workspace within the caller repository.

inputs.name: reports-directory
inputs.description: Optional normalized report-summary root.

inputs.name: observatory-snapshot
inputs.description: Optional public-safe Observatory read model for the represented commit.

inputs.name: default-branch
inputs.description: Optional caller default-branch override.

inputs.name: activity-since
inputs.description: Deterministic Git history window.

inputs.name: max-depth
inputs.description: Maximum repository tree depth.

inputs.name: artifact-retention-days
inputs.description: Retention for the generated public dashboard artifact.

outputs.name: artifact-name
outputs.description: Unique name of the uploaded Repository Intelligence site artifact.
